UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Root identity document for all account sub-collections. Access is strictly controlled to the authenticated owner (UID match). Owners have full read, create, and update permissions. v1.1.0

totalBotEarnings.description: Cumulative USD profit generated by the AI trading bot.

botActive.description: Whether the AI trading bot is currently active.

botAllocation.description: The current USD allocation limit for the AI bot.

WalletAsset.title: Wallet Asset
WalletAsset.description: Cryptographic vault document. Owners have full read/write access to their own assets sub-collection. v1.1.0

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Private financial ledger for the authenticated user. Owners have full read and create access. v1.1.0

/users/{userId}.description: Root user document. Authorizes owner-only access. v1.1.0

/users/{userId}/assets/{assetId}.description: Owner-only access to vault endpoints. v1.1.0
